invariants: One ordinary NSMatrix owns the group. Original NSButtonCell instances are retained by stable application IDs across reorder, title changes and model replacement.

Native deselectAllCells clears the previous owner selection before transfer; native setControlView transfers weak ownership before old matrix destruction. Removed members have that association cleared.
Native sizeToFit, cellFrameAtRow, selectedCell, keyCell, event interpretation and tracking remain original AppKit methods. No native drawing, geometry, keyboard or selection algorithm is copied.

The same shared backing path already used by text/popup controls supports NSMatrix lockFocus/drawCell during native key interpretation. A host view replacement preserves the existing window, input context, command filter and logical focus association.

The model is validated before native state is touched; invalid IDs, UTF8, membership and incomplete grids are rejected. Native tracking/dispatch reject model changes, geometry changes and destruction.
Three optional methods append at byte 480, retaining ABI 1 and previous offsets. Exact uint64 identities and an action counter distinguish native selection/key context from input focus.

Native provider/loader are candidate artifacts only. Unchanged browser adapters and current session host still use the prior native runtime; group transport and original engine model/DOM bindings are unfinished.
